Job Id: NBL-027-8010 — Flat 10, 30 Copperfield Walk, Willowbank, ZZ2 3ZZ

Hello,

Thank you for letting us know on 28 April that the bath drain cleared after using a plunger. We have closed this repair request: no contractor attended and no charge has been raised to you for it.

If the bath drains slowly again, please report it and we will arrange for it to be looked at. Please tell us straight away if water ever overflows, backs up, or there is a drain smell — we treat that as urgent.

Your separate question about a parking space in the underground garage is being handled outside this repair job. The enquiry sits with block management and a colleague will come back to you with their answer; we have not been given a date for their reply, so we will not promise one, but your question has not been forgotten.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
